pr_title: Fix compile error when using nlohmann ordered_map with WITH_DEFAULT macros

comments.comment: tests/src/unit-regression2.cpp unconditionally suppresses -Wself-assign-overloaded for Clang, but older Clang versions do not recognize that warning group and emit an unknown-warning diagnostic during the test build.
comments.expected_evidence: Point to tests/src/unit-regression2.cpp unconditionally suppressing -Wself-assign-overloaded with DOCTEST_CLANG_SUPPRESS_WARNING, which triggers unknown-warning diagnostics on older Clang.

pr_title: chore: disk backed backpressure for connections

comments.comment: `DiskBackedBackpressureQueue::unique_id` is incremented without synchronization in the constructor. Creating queues on multiple threads races on this shared counter and can assign duplicate or corrupted IDs.
comments.expected_evidence: Point to the static `size_t Connection::DiskBackedBackpressureQueue::unique_id` and the unsynchronized `id_ = ++unique_id;` in the constructor.

comments.comment: Backpressure reload reconstructs arguments by splitting the serialized command on `\0` in `LoadBackpressureFromDiskIfNeeded`. This loses correctness for binary-safe arguments that may contain embedded NUL bytes.
comments.expected_evidence: Point to `absl::StrSplit(read, '\0', absl::SkipEmpty())` after reconstructing command bytes in `LoadBackpressureFromDiskIfNeeded`.

comments.comment: The LimeOS logo entry in `src/logo/builtin.c` uses `FF_COLOR_FG_WHITE` for `.colors`, `.colorKeys`, and `.colorTitle`, making the output invisible on terminals with a light background.
comments.expected_evidence: In src/logo/builtin.c, the LimeOS entry sets `.colors`, `.colorKeys`, and `.colorTitle` to `FF_COLOR_FG_WHITE`, making the logo invisible on light-background terminals.

pr_title: fix(‎LibCarla): port lane marking, waypoint  loop, lane corners, and pugixml null fixes

comments.comment: In Map.cpp, the new `continue` on degenerate `edges` skips the `s_current += distancebetweentrees` step at the end of the loop. If `edges.first == edges.second` persists, the loop no longer makes progress and can hang.
comments.expected_evidence: Point to Map.cpp's while loop where `if (edges.first == edges.second) continue;` bypasses the bottom-of-loop `s_current += distancebetweentrees;` increment.

comments.comment: In MeshFactory.cpp, the refactor changes lane-mark edge computation to always use the extra lane width, which alters the previous solid/final-segment behavior that used zero extra width. This shifts lane marking positions on roads with non-zero extra lane width.
comments.expected_evidence: Point to MeshFactory.cpp call sites where ComputeEdgesForLanemark replaced direct GetCornerPositions(..., 0) behavior and now always uses extra lane width.

pr_title: fix(Unreal): return traffic sign bounding box from first trigger volume

comments.comment: BoundingBoxCalculator.cpp reads the first element of TrafficSign->GetTriggerVolumes() as a UBoxComponent without checking whether that entry is null, so this path can dereference a null trigger volume.
comments.expected_evidence: Point to BoundingBoxCalculator.cpp indexing TriggerVolumes[0] without validating that the first entry is non-null before dereferencing it.

pr_title: win,fs: handle AppExecLink reparse points in fstat

comments.comment: After `CloseHandle(handle)` at the bottom of the loop body in `fs__create_file`, `handle` is not set to `INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE`; if the loop runs all 32 iterations without resolving the path, the function falls through to `clean_and_ret_handle` and returns a closed (invalid) handle to the caller.
comments.expected_evidence: `CloseHandle(handle)` at the bottom of the loop body in `fs__create_file` without setting `handle = INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE`, causing the function to return a closed handle when the loop exhausts all 32 iterations.

comments.comment: In `editor/project_manager/project_list.cpp` under `NOTIFICATION_READY`, the callable for `update_title_size` is bound with an extra argument even though `update_title_size()` takes no parameters. This makes the deferred call and `size_changed` signal invocation fail with an argument-count error.
comments.expected_evidence: Point at project_list.cpp's bound callable in NOTIFICATION_READY where bind(false) adds an argument to update_title_size(), which is later defined with no parameters.

comments.comment: The deletion-path check in src/win/fs-event.c uses the wrong substring literal for the final handle path format. Matching "$Extend\$Deleted" here can miss the zombie directory path that appears as "\\$Extend\\$Deleted\\".
comments.expected_evidence: Point at the wcsstr check in src/win/fs-event.c that matches "$Extend\$Deleted" without the surrounding backslashes used by the final path format.

pr_title: Allow mpy-cross to exclude source lines

comments.comment: In mpy-cross/main.c, parsing for source-lines and no-source-lines is inside the MICROPY_EMIT_NATIVE conditional, so these options are ignored when native emit support is disabled.
comments.expected_evidence: Point to mpy-cross/main.c where source-lines/no-source-lines option parsing is nested under #if MICROPY_EMIT_NATIVE, making those options unavailable when native emit is off.

comments.comment: The OpenSSL-1.0.2+ fallback branch in src/event/ngx_event_openssl.c calls SSL_get_sigalgs() behind a version check that does not exclude AWS-LC, so this code can fail to compile when that function is unavailable.
comments.expected_evidence: Point to the #elif branch in src/event/ngx_event_openssl.c that calls SSL_get_sigalgs() under an OPENSSL_VERSION_NUMBER check that can still include AWS-LC, where the API is absent.

pr_title: Implement "Followup improvements for ext/uri" RFC - URI type detection

comments.comment: The first parameter of php_uri_parser_rfc3986_uri_type_read in uri_parser_rfc3986.c is declared as void* instead of the concrete type php_uri_parser_rfc3986_uris*, inconsistent with all other functions in this file.
comments.expected_evidence: php_uri_parser_rfc3986_uri_type_read in uri_parser_rfc3986.c declares its first parameter as void* but the header and all sibling functions use php_uri_parser_rfc3986_uris*

comments.comment: The declaration of php_uri_parser_rfc3986_uri_type_read in uri_parser_rfc3986.h declares the first parameter as void* instead of the concrete type php_uri_parser_rfc3986_uris*, unlike all other declarations in this header.
comments.expected_evidence: The declaration of php_uri_parser_rfc3986_uri_type_read in uri_parser_rfc3986.h uses void* for the first parameter instead of php_uri_parser_rfc3986_uris*

comments.comment: In src/cluster.c:isValidAuxChar, `isalnum` is still called with `c` instead of the unsigned-cast `ch`. Passing a negative non-EOF value to `isalnum` is undefined behavior on platforms with signed `char`.
comments.expected_evidence: Point to src/cluster.c:isValidAuxChar using isalnum(c) after casting to unsigned char ch, which leaves ctype called on possibly negative values.

comments.comment: In `isValidAuxChar` (cluster.c), `strchr(invalid_charset, c)` passes the original signed `int c` instead of the already-declared `unsigned char ch`; high-bit byte values sign-extend to negative integers, producing undefined behavior per C11 §7.4¶1.
comments.expected_evidence: In isValidAuxChar, `strchr(invalid_charset, c)` uses the original signed int `c` instead of `unsigned char ch`, same UB as the isalnum call above.
